# Fix It Proper

Fix It Proper is a website diagnosis tool for small business owners. A user pastes a
public website URL and gets a ranked list of specific fixes with the evidence behind
each one, plus AI rewrite suggestions labeled for testing.

## Key pages

- Home and analyzer (/): after sign in and a one time business profile, paste a
  URL, run deterministic SEO, technical, and accessibility checks plus Google
  PageSpeed, and read the ranked fix list.
- Privacy Policy (/privacy): what submitted URLs, fetched content, logs, and caches
  are kept, and the third parties used (Google PageSpeed Insights, Groq, Firebase).
- Terms and Conditions (/terms): acceptable use, AI suggestion disclaimer,
  availability, and liability.
- Contact (/contact): reach the operator by email or through the contact form.
- Sign in (/login) and Saved reports (/saved): accounts keep a 30-day report
  history. A business profile step (/onboarding) is required after first sign in.
- Creative review (/creative): uploaded ad images and public YouTube links get
  deterministic checks, an AI review, and an improved version with text overlays.
- Learn SEO basics (/learn/seo): what each SEO check means and how to fix it.
- Settings (/settings): edit the business profile, sign out, or delete the account.

## Notes for automated readers

- Results are checklists of found problems, not predictions of traffic or rankings.
- Public websites and landing pages only. Social media and ad platforms are refused.
- One page is analyzed per report. Sign in is required; reports are saved.
- Contact: xyber2307@gmail.com
